content: Go timers: pre-1.23 time.After in loops leaks timers until they fire; drain-after-Stop pattern (if !t.Stop() { <-t.C }) can deadlock if another goroutine already received; Go 1.23 changed Timer/Ticker channels to unbuffered - timers GC-able when unreferenced, Stop/Reset safe without draining. For retransmission backoff loops use a single reusable Timer with Reset on Go 1.23+ or select-with-done patterns; always Stop tickers via defer.
